- Fri 30 Apr, 14:30 CEST / 07:30 PDT

Quick heads-up — Vivek is on a redeye flight and actually lands at SFO at 07:10 PDT on Thu the 29th. He can make the call but requests we don't start before 08:30 PDT. That would push the CEST time later (16:30 PDT = 01:30 CEST next day) — which is messy.

Alternative proposals to avoid a middle-of-night for any party:
- Option A: Thu 29 Apr at 17:00 CEST / 08:00 PDT — Vivek can join but will be on a short nap; he prefers 08:30.
- Option B: Fri 30 Apr 09:00 CEST / 00:00 PDT — not great for Vivek.
- Option C (my vote): Fri 30 Apr 15:00 CEST / 06:00 PDT — still early for PDT but within business hours for EU/UK and gives Vivek time zone overlap.

I recommend Option A with the start time shifted to 17:30 CEST / 08:30 PDT so everyone is awake and we keep the meeting on Thu. Marcus — can you propose 17:30 CEST if that works for Marta and Liam?

Thanks,
Aisha Rahman
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
